scope: Every mark reaches your email service right away, and Companion checks that it did.

topics.title: Gmail's Important marker
details: To mark a Gmail message important, say "Mark as important", or press H. Press H again to take it off.
Your phone and the Gmail website show it too.
When you send from Gmail with high importance, your copy in Sent Mail gets the marker too.

topics.title: Read receipts
details: When a message asks for a read receipt, Companion asks you first. Say yes or no. Then it reads the message.
If Thunderbird is set to always or never send receipts, Companion does that and does not ask.

topics.title: Marks that reach your email service
details: Read, unread and flags now reach Gmail right away. Before, a mark could stay on this computer until Thunderbird was closed.
Companion waits for your email service to take each change. If it does not, Companion tries again on a new connection, then tells you.
Work email from Microsoft is checked right after each change too.

topics.title: Gmail conversations
details: Marking a Gmail message read marks its whole conversation read, as the Gmail website does. Opening it with Enter does too.

topics.title: Thunderbird
details: Thunderbird closes and opens again one time to get this change.
